item.title: Hot take - I don't like the way classic Tony Hawk controls
item.author: invalid@example.com (Mac|Payne)
item.dc:creator: Mac|Payne
item.content:encoded: I gave Tony Hawk 3+4 a try and I just can't get used to the way the game controls. The skater moving automatically is really annoying and the button layout is really awkward. I wish it controlled more like a car game, with accelerate and brake on the triggers. Once they introduced hopping out of the skateboard and allowed just running around, the gameplay became much better. Really wish they'd added an option to do that in the remakes. Would solve a lot of my frustration.
